apps.name: NBT Manager
apps.summary: The head unit side: the iDrive menu entry, signed installs and updates with rollback, the application bridge.

notes: ### New
- Touch on the manager's own screen: tap a row, drag to move through a list, swipe right for BACK. iDrive keeps its touches whenever it is shown. Applications do not take touches yet.

- Diagnostics look for the car's gateway. When the usual address does not answer, the manager tries the addresses the head unit already talks to on the car's Ethernet link and keeps the one that answers. With Debug log on, the Manager log says what it found there and what each address did.
- Car data reaches applications built as modules and guests.
### Fixed
- Self test: diagnostics and the phone page are checked by the native program, the only form that can do them; the sound check passes when queues only grew.
### Good to know
- Touch and the gateway search have not run in a car yet.
- There is no 0.5.4: its build failed and nothing was published.

apps.name: Gauges
apps.summary: Boost, temperatures, timing and more, read from the car's own computers. No OBD adapter.
apps.title: Live engine gauges

text: Live engine gauges: boost, lambda, ignition timing and per-cylinder corrections, fuel pressure, temperatures.
On a diesel, the particulate filter. The transmission: gear, wheel speeds and slip, drivetrain, torque and power curves.
Reads the engine computer (DME) through the car's gateway, read-only, as a diagnostic tester does.
iDrive's own car data fills in what the DME does not give.
Do not interact with it while driving.
Source, licences and notices: https://github.com/NBTFoundry/nf-gauges
notes: ### New

- The engine's values come through NBT Manager's diagnostics, shared with other applications. At install the car says what Gauges may read: the engine, gearbox, transfer case and stability control units, reading only.
### Improved
- TORQUE & POWER: smooth curves without jitter or stray points when the pedal moves or the gearbox shifts; power in horsepower, in white beside the torque.
- TRANSMISSION: a line at the engine's speed on the curves.
- The demo drive follows the dyno pull of an M5.
- The gateway's address is read from the head unit's shared setting first, as other diagnostic tools on the head unit do.
### Good to know
- Needs NBT Manager 0.4.0 or later.
- On a car where NBT Manager reaches no gateway, Gauges shows iDrive's car data but no engine values (seen on a G31). NBT Manager 0.5.5 looks for the gateway by itself.

apps.name: Diagnostics
apps.summary: Read and clear the fault codes of the car's main control units, on the iDrive screen or the phone.
apps.title: Fault codes

text: Fault codes of the car's main units: engine, gearbox, transfer case, stability control, airbags, steering, body.
Read them on the iDrive screen or the phone, and clear them while the car stands still.
Codes are shown as BMW's tools print them, without descriptions.
Source, licences and notices: https://github.com/NBTFoundry/nf-diagnostics
notes: ### New

- First release: the fault codes of eight control units (engine, second engine computer, gearbox, transfer case, stability control, airbags, steering, body), read and cleared on the iDrive screen or in the phone app.
- Codes are six hex digits, as BMW's tools print them, with their state (active, stored, pending).
- Codes are cleared only when the car is parked.
### Good to know
- Needs NBT Manager 0.4.0 or later.
- On a car where NBT Manager reaches no gateway, no unit answers (seen on a G31). NBT Manager 0.5.5 looks for the gateway by itself.
